description: This file implements a dashboard application for Playwright, including server setup, WebSocket handling, browser connection management, and UI initialization.

classes.name: HttpServer
classes.description: A custom HTTP server class used for serving files and handling API requests.

classes.name: DashboardConnection
classes.description: Represents a dashboard WebSocket connection associated with a browser descriptor.

classes.name: CDPConnection
classes.description: Represents a Chrome DevTools Protocol connection for a specific page.

methods.name: readBody
methods.description: Reads and parses the JSON body from an HTTP request.

methods.name: parseRequest
methods.description: Parses incoming request to extract a GUID, ensuring the request body contains it.

methods.name: sendJSON
methods.description: Sends a JSON response with specified data and status code.

methods.name: loadBrowserDescriptorSessions
methods.description: Loads active browser sessions from the server registry and constructs session statuses.

methods.name: handleApiRequest
methods.description: Handles API requests for listing, closing, and deleting browser sessions.

methods.name: openDashboardApp
methods.description: Sets up the HTTP server, WebSocket routes, launches the dashboard page, and navigates to it.

methods.name: launchApp
methods.description: Launches a Chromium browser context with specific arguments and prepares the dashboard page.

methods.name: syncLocalStorageWithSettings
methods.description: Synchronizes localStorage settings between the filesystem and the page.

methods.name: socketsDirectory
methods.description: Returns the directory path for Playwright daemon sockets.

methods.name: dashboardSocketPath
methods.description: Constructs the socket path for the dashboard based on the username hash.

methods.name: acquireSingleton
methods.description: Creates or reuses a singleton server socket for the dashboard.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that manages server startup and dashboard initialization.
